FieldNotes.Comments: Site is located on a deforested area, located on top of a small ridge, and set up in an 'x' array. There are many dead trees and mulch covering the entire site. The area is covered in sandy mud. Potential noise sources include a road located approximately 500 m to the south of the site center, there are a few houses about 250 meters away.
